description: Enterprise integration: AiDr commit gateway verdict-check enforcement. MUST verify ZO-SENTINEL verdict before forwarding commits. MUST NOT auto-commit CAUTION_LIMITED or HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED verdicts without explicit override. MUST include injection_resilience score in commit payload. Query verdict via write_service :8772. Use numbered constraints: (1) Check verdict tier from trust_synthesiser output, (2) Reject HIGH_RISK_ISOLATED/KNOWN_THREAT automatically, (3) Require override flag for CAUTION_LIMITED, (4) Include all signal scores in payload. Reference Phase 9 plan. No HTTP between daemons.
